# Ecclesiastes Chapter 12 -- Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-12

This log records all verses in Ecclesiastes Chapter 12 where the three translators significantly diverged.

---

## 12:5 — "caperberry" vs. "desire"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "desire fails" | *aviyyonah* as abstract "desire" |
| LOGOS | "desire fails" | Same |
| PNEUMA | "the caperberry no longer stirs desire" | *aviyyonah* as "caperberry" (aphrodisiac) |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted "desire no longer is stirred" — abstract reading fits the allegory better.

---

## 12:8 — "vanity of vanities" vs. "vapor of vapors"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "Vapor-of-vapors" | Literal |
| LOGOS | "Vanity of vanities" | Traditional |
| PNEUMA | "Everything is meaningless" | Dynamic |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted "Vapor of vapors" — project-wide consistency for *hevel*.

---

## 12:13 — "the whole of the human" vs. "the whole duty of man"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "this is the-whole of-the-human" | No "duty" in Hebrew |
| LOGOS | "this is the whole duty of man" | Traditional, supplies "duty" |
| PNEUMA | "this is everyone's duty" | Dynamic |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted "the whole duty of mankind" — supplies "duty" for clarity, "mankind" for inclusivity.

**Status:** All resolved.
